reviews.text: Amazing and kind team, reasonable pricing, the place you want to be if you ever find yourself in an emergency with your pets!

I have a cat with urine crystals that I was concerned about not keeping liquids or foods down. Since I already had seen my primary and they were closed until Monday, I was extremely anxious because my cat wasn’t clearly showing signs of being in a lot of pain. I called the overnight doctor and she had about a 5 minute call with me explaining that I should probably come in just for a quick evaluation, so we packed up and left. For it being 2:30 am and there being several other families in there, I was checked in and taken care of so quickly. There’s water and lot of snacks out front. The techs that checked me in were very sweet and it was clear they knew what they were doing. Within probably 10 minutes of me being there they had already taken all of her vitals and assured me that she was going to be okay and they would send the doctor in to go over treatment options with me. They told me there was only one overnight doctor so it might be a bit of a wait while she treats patients in worse condition, we ended up only waiting about another 20 probably. The doctor that came in to explain treatment options was so helpful and kind, she explained what I could and could not add to my treatment package because I was already seen by my primary vet. Nothing felt like an upsell or like they wanted to run random additional tests. She sent me my invoice via text which was super easy to pay online, and within another 10 minutes two more techs were in to administer my cat her liquids and painkillers. It’s not easy to give cats shots, but these two managed to explain exactly what every medication does and why they’re doing it, what side effects may occur, while holding my cat and administering the medication. She didn’t even make any noise until the 3rd or 4th shot. They gave me my at-home medication as well as helpful tools like pill crushers, answered all my questions and told me at exactly what times I should be administering myself. It’s really so obvious that everyone here loves their job and cares about what they do, which makes you feel amazing when you’re at an ER at 2am. Serious thank you to everyone that helped Birdie and I last night. If I could make an E-Vet my primary I would!
Truly amazing doctors and staff- they are saints and just incredible people- Millierose below agrees!

I was incredibly impressed with the team and service at VEG ER in Lincoln Park on North Ave. I took my cat in for an emergency in the late evening and they were ready to help right away. Each team member showed genuine care and affection for my cat and it made the experience much less stressful than I had expected it to be. Highly recommend coming to VEG ER if your pet needs medical support.
Dr Nemsick, along with the other vets and vet techs, made me feel so comfortable and cared for! They helped my dog Maisy make a full recovery!
Absolute exceptional staff. From the Front Desk staff to the Dr. All of the staff were caring, friendly, and patient.

I can't recommend VEG ER enough! I was thoroughly impressed from the entire team. Everyone from the front desk to the vet techs and the vets were incredibly kind, compassionate, and efficient. I love the open layout and that they let you stay with your pet in the rooms as long as possible.  Unfortunately my cat needed to be hospitalized for several nights, but they kept me updated regularly and let us visit with her.  I give them all the credit for why my cat is still alive today and couldn't be more grateful. Thank you VEG!!

Extremely compassionate and kind staff all the way from the receptionist to the vets. They put my cat, Luna, to sleep with respect and consideration of how heartbroken I am - I did not feel rushed in saying goodbye.
Thank you for your 5-star rating, Shana! If you ever have any questions, please don't hesitate to give us a call at any time to speak with a doctor.

Our baby boy was seen and treated right away. The staff explained everything very clearly and sent over notes and reminders. Parking is free (at the back) and there’s an area at the back for driver to drop us off.

VEG is exceptional, and this is the only place to go for a pet emergency. They are extremely professional and responsive, and went out of their way to ensure our pet was confortable during his over night stay.

I was transferred over to VEG from Medvet when my cat swallowed a sewing needle and thread this past week and I wish I would’ve come here first. After a terrible experience with Medvet, the VEG team was an incredible breath of fresh air. The receptionist greeted us with assurance that the team was already prepping for the procedure, the techs were incredibly efficient and sweet with my cat, the procedure team Garret, Zoe and Gina allowed me to stay with my cat and explained everything as they did it, Dr. Hamza was amazing and efficient and even sweetly got me a cool jar to hold the sewing needle as a souvenir. The entire VEG team made a horrifying, stressful, exhausting experience as good as it possibly could be and I couldn’t be more grateful. Thank you!

My elderly kitty has a chronic respiratory illness that sometimes flares up badly where she needs urgent help. Any time we’ve had to go to VEG (instead of her primary care) they have been outstanding. They do all they can to ensure kitties have a small, secluded place of their own while waiting on care. And they let (and encourage) you to stay with them even during some smaller procedures (blood draws, ultra sounds etc, nothing surgical of course) so you can help keep them calm if you want. Really can’t recommend this place enough for emergency/urgent vet needs. I wish they also had primary care office! They seem very good at prioritizing critical care patients but also keeping you updated along the way on wait times (if applicable) and what’s happening with your pet’s care. Very well organized. And all of the staff and vets I’ve ever interacted with there have been both knowledgeable and caring. I’ve also found the vets to be really good at explaining things and never pushy about running tests/procedures that aren’t imperative.

Just go here if you and yours need help. Words do not describe my dog Gus’s and my experience.  We are all walking in that door needing help in a state of mental distress and everyone handles this differently.  What I witnessed was a cool and organized staff with the ability to ease minds and work with many different personalities and pet-alities.  Yes, I was “able to witness.”  Walked in with my dog in a bit of numb fear around 1:45am Labor Day.  My first thought once I arrived was “that was fast” and my second was “oh wow… we are all together?”  Next thought “Oh wow! We are all in this together!!!”  Life altering positive perspective change.  BTW it was very busy, sadly some things were critical, but this team is calm and well oiled under high stakes pressure. Thank you for being open and give this staff a raise. These people are superb. I have zero negative to say about one human being I encountered and we were there for days so we met many.  Every ER my daytime vet typically refers basically turned us away when I called them.  Not because they thought I was overreacting, they were also worried, but fully disclosed a minimum six hours INITIAL wait.  When I called the VEG I spoke to an actual doctor who did a triage in that moment.  They were correct. I truly believed my dog would have died  without that conversation.
Dr. C was on duty initially and during (although she was supposed to be off duty at some point but continued to press through with tireless devotion) and was the person I spoke with on the phone before I left my house.  All I really need to say is that conversation helped me make my decision to leave immediately (during that call they had multiple critical cases and were beyond slammed, plus I think she pressed through about 48 hours nonstop that I know of).  Christina, also there  initially was incredibly supportive while
my dog was having a very bad time.  But the whole staff is amazing; all of the shifts and all of the days I was there.  I was too shocked, stressed and exhausted to remember names, so I apologize to everyone else, all deserving special mention, but I hope this conveys and I thank you all for your service.  Photos are during treatment and directly after release and a bath.

I have nothing but good things to say about my experience with VEG. Dr. Kilcrease is exactly who you want caring for your pet in an emergency. She was calm, informative, comforting, and validating. I was so impressed with how she communicated with me and treated my cat. Emergency veterinary medicine is definitely her calling and she is so good at it. Chandler and Mirabella were excellent nurses. They were so accommodating. They eased my worries and treated me and my cat with kindness. They explained everything they were doing and why it was being done. I am so grateful for the care they provided. Ash at the front desk was very comforting when discussing the financials - of course it was expensive and scary - but she helped me feel at ease and answered all my questions and shared all the options with me.

I know there are others who cared for my cat during his stay there. I am so grateful for each of you. I hope I don't have to go back, but I will recommend VEG in Lincoln Park to anyone and everyone who needs emergency vet care.

We had such an amazing experience with our elderly, sick Pom. The entire team took such good care of him and supported us in making difficult decisions and exploring care options. I would without a doubt return to VEG and this location.

We had to bring our dog here at 12:30am last weekend because he helped himself to a bunch of desserts that had macadamia nuts and raisins in them. Every single employee from the vet to the assistant techs to the person working at the desk were so kind, compassionate, and left us very confident with the care they were providing. They kept us informed every step of the way, allowed us to ask questions and didn't judge why we were there. Everyone was so incredible and gave our boy so much love. While we hope we won't have to go back, we will always choose this location if we need to.

Brought my dog Dakota here for an emergency. They helped me figure out how to pay for his visit and although I acted like such a cry baby bc I was so worried how I could afford his emergency care and obviously for my baby’s well being. Everyone was so professional & kind and kept checking on my dog & even me asking if I needed anything. They even had me wait to make sure before we left Dakota got any better after his meds. They truly care for the pets that come in (& the owners🥲) Thank you so much to this office and team members, I truly appreciate you all 🐾

One can only hope that someday ERs for humans will function as well as VEG Pet ER performed today. Every individual was outstanding and every individual’s performance exceeded expectations! Kudos to the team!

My cat had a sudden medical issue today.  I had. No idea what was happening but she appeared to have something stuck in her mouth.  I brought her to VEG and they were able to find a piece of plastic or something stuck in her gums.  They took it out and she is fine now.  I am grateful to Dr. Mettenburg and the team for caring for my cat and getting the issue resolved.  I didn’t have to wait to be seen either.  They took me in immediately.

If I could give 100 stars I would!!!!! I wish there were individuals I could recognize as stand out to give them shout outs but truly EVERY SINGLE person there was the most amazing, caring, calming, helpful, professional, knowledgeable individual I could possibly wish to be taking care of my pet. Even the employees that were working on other animals were so incredibly kind and comforting. I will absolutely (and have already begun to) recommend this place to anyone looking for amazing emergency care for their animals. THANK YOU VEG LINCOLN PARK 🫶🫶🫶🫶
Thank you for 5 stars Anna!

Everyone I encountered here was very kind and they do seem to care. Extremely kind. Kindness aside though I went in with my constipated cat. After $1400 (this included the exam, an x ray, a blood test, an enema, and a couple of shots) I left with a still constipated cat after what sounded like one very unsuccessful enema, and a prescription laxative. The cost would have been the same anywhere I went my problem is I came in with a constipated cat and left with a constipated, but heavily drugged cat. Now I'm back where I started because the prescription laxative I could have just picked up at my normal vet is not working to remove anything. I do think the staff is capable here, but in my case if I had the chance to go back in time and go to a clinic not VEG affiliated that would have properly treated the constipation (the entire reason for the visit) more aggressively I would have.
Wonderful staff, they really take care of all their pets as if they are their own.

We took our dog Honey here today after she was attacked by a dog. The staff was very caring, treated our dog so well, and explained everything we need to do to continue to take care of her. Dr. Kayla and one other male tech were exceptional with Honey. Thanks for taking such good care of her!

Dr. Cave performed the surgery on Catrick (amputation of hind leg) and made sure he was good for discharge before I could pick him up. The team was super thorough and everyone was so kind. I’m really grateful to her and her whole team and dr. Rushing and her team — any pet emergency I would highly recommend. In fact, I wish they could be my regular vet.
I had to take my dog in as she couldn’t put any pressure on her front paw. We got in quickly and they examined her. Everyone is fantastic! Prices expected for a weekend ER visit. Highly recommend VEG

We didn’t know places like this exist. Our senior dog had a crisis, suddenly needing care. We called ahead, walked in the lobby, and didn’t even sit down — we were greeted warmly and taken straight back to start the exam. Every staff interaction was so nice, from front desk, to doctors, to techs… They were calm and reassuring, let us stay with her for everything, let her get her IV next to us in the lobby (which had some snacks and water for us)…. Instructions and meds were well explained, and my husband and I left a little teary-eyed at how well we were all cared for and supported. A+
VEG is the best care, hands down.

Took my baby in last night and was incredibly impressed at how this clinic was running. They were clearly having a SLAMMED and stressful night, and continued to be compassionate, clear, and caring, as well as transparent about how they were working. All in all, the care Dr. Shanks gave was thorough and staff were incredible to work with.
Thank you for 5 stars Zach!
Incredible staff, speedy service

My sweet cat fell ill very quickly and landed us at VEG. This review does not have a happy ending; he had an aggressive tumor and we decided to put him to rest instead of putting him through chemo with scant prospects for extending his life with any quality. It was one of the worst days of my adult life. And, I will never forget the kindness in Dr. Gonzalez's eyes, his patience as we discussed what was happening and all of the factors and scenarios that lay before me, and his extreme care in making sure that I had as much time as I needed and we gave my cat a peaceful send off. It's never easy keeping our end of the bargain as pet owners in these moments, but VEG facilitated it professionally and kindly.
I recommend them.

My 4-year-old cat, Larry, came to VEG Lincoln Park on Sunday night with a life-threatening urinary obstruction. He was critically ill, and the team unblocked him, placed a catheter, and stabilized him. I am genuinely grateful because they saved his life that night. Meanwhile, the cost was over $3,000 for the first day, super high for me because i don't have insurance, but that is not my main concern.

My concern is what happened Tuesday night. I was told Larry’s kidney values were still very high and that he seemed to be re-blocking after the catheter was removed. The doctor said Larry might have some underlying kidney disease and recommended euthanasia. I was shocked and said I would not euthanize him. I asked whether they could unblock him again or continue IV fluids, but I was told those were not options. When I said I wanted to take Larry home, I was asked if I was sure and told that Larry would suffer a lot and they were open to me to bring Larry back for euthanasia if no other places would take him.

Overall, I felt so hopeless from the conversation with the doctor as there was no options at all, and I felt strongly pressured to euthanize Larry when I still wanted to give him a chance. However, I especially want to thank the nurse who had cared for Larry for two days. Before discharge, she found someone to help unblock Larry again even though the doctor told me there was no way to do it, and gave me canned food and medications to take home. I am very grateful to her.

I took Larry home. That night, he urinated a lot on his own and ate very well. The next day, I brought him to another veterinarian. Repeat bloodwork showed that his kidney function had improved dramatically and was already very close to normal. He has continued to improve since then. The new veterinarian was also able to help Larry empty his bladder with gentle manual pressure, without needing another catheterization or any complicated procedure. Larry is now stable and doing very well.

I understand that Larry was critically ill and that euthanasia sometimes needs to be discussed. My concern is how strongly it was pushed when there was still uncertainty about whether his kidneys could recover.

Had I agreed to euthanasia Tuesday night, Larry would not be alive today. I am grateful VEG saved him initially, but I am even more grateful that I trusted my instincts, sought a second opinion, and gave Larry more time.

5 gold stars for every staff member in this place! Thank you so much! Our dog Banana received top notch care here from everyone and Dr Cave was very professional and compassionate in helping Banana giving us peace of mind over his condition. Highly recommend.
Thank you for an amazing experience with our pets 💕 …
Everyone was so helpful and caring and treated my Waffles(guinea pig) so well. Thank you!

Can’t speak highly enough about VEG on North Ave. brought my dog aggressive (and not super vet friendly) dog in who was suffering from severe allergy reaction and potentially anaphylactic. They were patient, kind, treated her quick and on her terms. Ellie and Gaby are exceptional as well as Dr. Shanks and Dr. N
Thank you, John! Our team is here for you and your pet 24/7!

Everyone here is so kind! Dr. Cave and the night shift team took the time to listen to all my concerns and really made me feel heard. Ralphie is very nervous and they did everything they could to ease his anxiety and make him comfortable. Thank you so much, from me and Ralphie!

I was incredibly impressed with the team at VEG and really grateful for my experience there. One of my cats was having a health emergency, and the moment we arrived they took us right back for initial triage, got his vitals, and got him set up and comfortable and let me stay right near him until the veterinarian was ready to see him. Throughout the whole experience, the doctor was very communicative about the diagnosis and proposed treatment plan, and everyone there made sure we were comfortable and knew what was happening. The cost was reasonable and level of care and service was way beyond expectations. Highly recommend.

Literally the best people on earth! They diagnosed our Daisy girl with stage 4 kidney disease. They have done everything in their power to help us and our girl! I wish we could use them as our family vet! They are all the best!

VEG took phenomenal care of our dog. He was diagnosed with cancer earlier in the week at VEG, and within days he had to leave us. The team at VEG made him comfortable every step of the way and supported us throughout the process. I cannot say enough about how empathetic, kind, and caring this team truly is. I highly recommend them. They explained everything to us, our options, and what quality of life and his timeline looked like at diagnosis. At his passing, they assured us we were making the best decision for him.  They cared for him and our family throughout the entire process. We are so grateful to VEG.

I will never forget the immense kindness, care, and compassion the VEG team showed my husband and I when we brought our precious baby in with a diabetic crisis that ultimately led to her passing yesterday. Our hearts are shattered, but we are so grateful that we had this incredible team supporting us in our worst moment. Thank you for the care you showed our Ivy until the very end and beyond.

If your pet needs urgent care, this is the place to go. They are a true light in this world.

Although we have unfortunately been to VEG more than we’d like with our dog, every visit has been as pleasant as possible and very thorough.  Everyone here seems to care about the welfare of both you and your pet.  The doctors and technicians are honest with great bedside manner.  They treat your pet like a family member.  This will always be my first choice for ER care in Chicago.
Everyone is ready and available to immediately assist with your peer and explained everything thoroughly. Made sure I was comfortable as well. Thank you guys!

Jeanette was fantastic! Super helpful and reassuring. Zero stars to the short man with a pixie cut and patchy beard that came from the back to yell at me. Jeanette apologized and was reassuring after that, too.
The best of the best.   They actually care.
Thank you, Wendy! We are here for you and your pet 24/7!

Staff is great, service is great - but prices are insane.  I know it’s for emergencies but $450 for a bee sting is ridiculous.  Almost as bad as human prices.  Probably PE firm run.  But what can you do.  🤷‍♀️ …

Everyone at this clinic was incredible. We brought our cat in terrified that she was very sick. They not only helped her immediately, but comforted us that it was something very treatable. The facility was fantastic. Being able to stay with our cat during her treatment was comforting to her and us. The staff blew us away with their kindness, knowledge, and clarity. Thank you SO much!

Words can’t describe how thankful I am for having the team here take care of our little Winston. Every single person we interacted with on multiple occasions from the doctors to the nurses were just phenomenal, kind, compassionate and professional.

The VEG staff and vets were so wonderful and kind when I brought my dog in for an emergency. Eventually we had to put her down and I felt totally informed and supported. They gave everything to me kindly and straight forward and gave me private space to be with her before she went. The follow up and memorial were so smooth and professional. Very grateful we went for during a difficult time.

I can't say enough good things about this rescue. They went above and beyond to help save a kitten, and it was clear from the start that they truly care about the lives of animals—not just the money. Everyone I dealt with was professional, honest, compassionate, and genuinely dedicated to helping. It's hard to find such great people in the city these days, and this organization restored my faith that they still exist. I'm incredibly grateful for their help and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a VET that truly puts animals first. Thank you guys for bringing kindness to this world. I will never stop telling people how amazing this place is.

Absolutely wonderful place. Every staff member I encountered was lovely and caring. I had brought in a community cat that was not doing great and the compassion Dr. Kayla displayed was indescribable. Unfortunately, we were not able to save the cat but the care Dr. Kayla and her colleagues gave to him was amazing. Truly, I have no words to describe the amazing people that work there. Thank you!

Great doctors and great staff.

If you’re in the area and have a bunny, this place is great for an emergency. They acted fast and are so kind.

They really took care of my bunny and stabilized him! He’s currently at home with us now but they really took care of him during his overnight stay. If you’re a bunny parent you know the anxiety of having such a fragile little creature. I recommend this place. They took my concerns of GI stasis very seriously.
Thank you, Yash! We are here for you and your pet 24/7!
Thank you, Ryan! If you ever have any questions, please don't hesitate to give us a call at anytime to speak with a doctor.
Thank you, Breanne! We are here for you and your pet 24/7!

I was very impressed with my overall experience. I had never been to a veterinary emergency facility before, and I was very worried and scared. From being able to talk to a doctor on the phone to being triaged for vitals right when I walked in, to the amenities in the waiting room (including umbrellas for people when it started raining!), to the doctor coming out multiple times to talk to me during my visit, I felt like I was being taken care of and that my pet was in wonderful hands. At one point the doctor came out to share that there was a wait but that she was getting through patients and would see us soon. It was very calming and the couple next to me said she was a great doctor and they were glad she was working. Would come back here for any vet emergency and recommend to others.

A lot of people say that emergency vets just try to treat symptoms, not diagnose, but that statement absolutely does not apply here! The whole team at VEG immediately seemed dedicated to not only helping my kitty Sweet Pea feel better, but figure out why she wasn't feeling well. Even while surrounded by stressful situations, the entire staff from reception to the vet techs to the vets themselves, led with kindness, love, and understanding. I felt like my concerns were heard the entire time, everything was explained to me before and after decisions, including prices, and being able to be with my girl the whole time made all of my anxiety feel a lot better. We had the pleasure of visiting two nights in a row and even with different staff, we had the same incredible experience. It's hard to not be anxious, scared, and upset when your furry friend isn't feeling better and they absolutely empathize with you too. It is clear these people are all passionate, knowledgeable, and dedicated as well as true animal lovers. I wish they had a non-emergency clinic because of how much both I and Sweet Pea loved them!

This is a standout facility with expert care and an unusual setup which promotes transparency between the care team and pet owners.

My dog had an emergency which required us to spend several hours at the location in Lincoln Park. While we waited for blood work results, my dog and I sat in the general triage care room and saw how owners were encouraged to stay with their pets while they were being treated and in some cases, operated on. I can say firsthand, what an impressive team of doctors and vet techs, who are wiling to put their work and skills on display.

My dog was in late stage renal failure and we did not have long, but the team was professional, informative, engaged in a solution, calming, empathetic, and kind as we learned of his diagnosis. They were extremely supportive in helping plan end of life for my sweet Milo. I can't recommend this facility and team enough.
So late but I did not forget! They were awesome with Monchhichi! Thank you for taking care of her and making sure she was ok.

Our dog decided to make Monday night interesting and book a trip to the ER. Despite it being midnight, the staff at VEG was lively, extremely welcoming and supportive. Throughout the X-rays, drawing blood, IV drugs, the whole deal - there was always someone there to talk us through it (and more importantly comfort our puppy). Before and after photos of Birdie’s ordeal!

VEG is a wonderful place to take a pet for emergency care. My dog was having issues standing up and was so lethargic. They took us back immediately. I love that you can stay with your pet during their care. The doc came up with a plan and very kindly explained our options. They gave a detailed explanation of what  medications he needed and how they would help him. I was expecting a list of tests to be ordered instead they treated the acute symptoms. Less than 10 hours later my pup is showing improvement, and I'll be able to take him for a follow up with his regular vet.

An amazing experience for me and my dog in a moment of sickness. I got to spend the night with my boy while he healed. Incredible experience 10/10 - will always take me dogs here if they are having an emergency
Outstanding care and remarkable staff.  Thank you!

Everyone was so kind! That’s what we want with our animals, right? They let us know exactly what they were doing and did it all in front of us: and in our case cleaned up our dogs sutures, used medical glue to fix the minor tears, and gave us some meds to help our dog mend up in the next few days.  I don’t have enough kind words for the staff, even watching them with other animals they delivered ten fold. Thank you VEG. ❤️A normal shitty experience didn’t feel that way and from Murphy and co it meant the world.

The team at VEG took such fantastic care of our pitsky, Adele, when we had to rush her to emergency care twice over the span of a week for pale gums and bloody vomit. It was a scary time for us, but throughout Adele's overnight stay (where we got to stay right with her in a private room), we were reassured she was in expert hands with folks who were providing exceptional care as they diagnoses her with ulcers and gastritis. We received regular updates, thorough explanations of invoices & estimates, and streamlined communications. On our second visit, when we learned Adele needed more intensive care, the team quickly got us connected to MedVet so she could have a blood transfusion. I'm sorry I don't remember everyone's name who supported us, but Michael, Rowan, Chrissy, Kiandra (sp? ultrasound tech! and the tech in training!), Dr. Kruzova, Dr. Gulson, Dr. Billand, and the other doctors, nurses, and staff who supported overnight Monday 6/29 - Tuesday 6/30, as well as 7/5, all took such great care of Adele (and her moms!). The team was also super helpful with my follow up calls and questions. We cannot thank you enough for all have done for our sweet girl.
Nobody wants to go to an ER but if you have to, this specific location has a superhero staff.
Thank you for 5 stars Ashley!
Thank you, Daniel! We are here for you and your pet 24/7!
Phenomenal care and service for our dog! This is our 3rd visit and we have a positive experience each time! The staff and doctor are patient and caring.
Next level care and service for my pup even at 4am. Thank you

brought my puppy he was really sick. we did outpatient care. and still got a bill of 1300$. he didn’t survive and passed. we called them to hold his body for us til we could get him to a cremation center early tomorrow & they refused. so now we have no where to put our sweet boy who passed away under their treatment plan & they refuse to store him for one night even though they do have storage available. i know this because my senior dog was stored here when i had to get him euthanized years ago. it sucks because ive always trusted VEG. he’s such a small puppy too. i understand if he was a dog that wasn’t a patient there why they would say no, but we got a bill of over 1000$ and he was an established patient and we were still under their care plan. we JUST took him home. we talked to our primary vet today when they were open and they made us aware that there’s was a shot he could’ve been given to stop the disease from spreading throughout his body and give him a chance. they didn’t even mention it. so i feel like i wasn’t given the full opportunity to save my puppy. i made this review because to my surprise, my primary vet recommended to never go to this emergency hospital again . she said they have a history with overcharging while not providing you with all the information you need to make informed decisions on your pets care. she was also shocked to discover they didn’t make us aware about the shot being an option.  i’m never here to bash any buisness but this is just extremely unfortunate and devastating and i wish VEG would’ve handled this with any sort of compassion and love for our sweet boy. i realized they don’t care about your animal, just what is in your pockets. they told us if we really needed to store him for a night, we’d have to pay an extra 500$ fee.
Thank you for 5 stars Luz!

We’ve had a very stressful two weeks with our cat and a previous urgent care clinic. We kept being told that sedation was the only option to do lab work and they were unwilling to cooperate with our cats behavior- even though he was visibly in pain. I decided to get a second opinion, and I’m so happy I went with the team here! Our cat has been struggling with bladder pain and they saw this as a reason for his stress & anxiety rather than treat him like a burden on the exam table. Their patience and gentle handling of our cat helped lift a huge relief off of our shoulders to let us know he was in safe hands.

TLDR: Misdiagnosed my cat, she spent an extra week not getting on the proper treatment path.

Two parts to this review on why I’m leaving 2 stars.

My cat was having urinary tract problems and my normal Vet/provider was not able to see her because of on going surgery taking place at their office. So I brought my cat here based on their recommendation.

The staff itself was incredibly kind, and had good bedside care(not sure of the proper thing to call it for a cat).

The Doctor came back with her test results and showed me that she had a large amount of bacteria in her bladder and that she had a UTI, so we put her on antibiotics and I figured she would get better.

Fast forward to a week later, she had made no progress and had actually gotten worse. I took her into my normal vet for her 7 day follow up and the first thing my vet says after reading the original diagnostics was that my pet does not have a confirmed UTI. I was shocked to hear this because the emergency vet doctor said she had a bladder full of bacteria. My vet stated that she had blood in her urine sample and there was no conclusive way to say there was bacteria unless they did a urine culture (while looking at the exact same results). So we did a urine culture and it turns out she did not have a UTI. So my cat went a week without getting the proper care because of this misdiagnosis and lack of proper additional testing.

Chella is home and feeling completely like herself again. I cannot recommend VEG more highly. Transparent communication, genuine warmth, and real expertise at every step of what is inevitably a stressful night.

Bottom line -if you are looking for a good ER Vet, this is the group to go see. and again I hope everything will work out for your pet.

I wanted to take a moment to share feedback about my experience at your hospital. Before anything else, I truly appreciate the stress and responsibility that comes with treating pets who are unwell.

Now , with some distance and time, do I feel ready to share.

When I first brought my cat in, I explained that I was under significant financial strain after a recent move and job change. I was anxious, crying, and doing my best to ask realistic questions about his prognosis, whether treatment could help him recover or whether the focus might shift to comfort. Despite my efforts to be honest about my situation, I felt judged. At one point, the vet responded to me with, “Well, what do you mean by that?” when I said I had financial limits. Later, after treatment, I was told, “Since your budget could only cover $5,000, we did the best we could. He (the cat) really should stay another night but again since you have a budget we have to honor that I guess.” That statement left me feeling guilty, ashamed, and as though I had failed my cat, even though I had stretched myself and my family’s support as much as possible.

I understand how challenging these conversations can be, and I deeply respect the work veterinarians do every day. I am sharing this now because I hope it can be used constructively. No client facing both medical and financial stress should leave feeling more guilt or shame than they already carry. Empathy and reassurance, even in difficult financial circumstances, can make an immeasurable difference.

As a new foster parent, I welcomed a 7-week-old kitten named Brownie into my home on July 4th, unaware of the challenging journey ahead. My rescue had informed me that Brownie had been severely injured in an unknown incident, leaving her with a broken rear leg and a badly damaged ear reduced to cartilage. When I picked her up, her leg was loosely bandaged, and I was given gabapentin to manage her pain.
While settling her into her playpen at home, I noticed movement under her bandage. To my shock and horror, I discovered maggots infesting her wounded leg. I immediately rushed Brownie to the Veterinary Emergency Group (VEG) in Lincoln Park, where Dr. Jacob Schanks and his compassionate team welcomed us with open arms. From the moment we arrived, they treated Brownie like family, working tirelessly to ease her pain, remove the maggots, clean her wound, apply a fresh bandage, and carefully remove the remnants of her unsalvageable ear.
The level of transparency here is unparalleled; They invited me into the back to witness every step of Brownie’s care, a level of openness I’ve never experienced at any other veterinary clinic. Their warmth and dedication made a frightening situation feel manageable and hopeful.
Ultimately, Brownie needed her leg amputated, and Dr. Schanks went above and beyond, coordinating her transfer to PAWS Chicago, where skilled surgeons performed the procedure. I’m endlessly grateful to Dr. Schanks and the entire VEG team—Stacey, Darce, Carlos, Becky, Adam, Vanessa, Joey, Camill, Chandler, Michael, Kelly, and Jose—for their extraordinary care and kindness during Brownie’s time of need. Before we left, the entire staff signed his little cast and drew little pictures on it.  It was so sweet to see how much they adored him. Not to mention, the Dr. was very transparent about what was going on, what it would cost, what his prognosis was, etc.
The next time I had to take him to the emergency vet, without hesitation we went to the LP VEG.  This time, he had gotten into some candy (no xylitol), and it caused him to literally swell up.  After a lot of tests and and overnight stay (out of an abundance of caution on my end), my baby came home better than ever.  I even received a call the next morning from the vet that he had spent his free time throughout the night researching and discussing with other vets on staff what would have caused him to swell up the way he did, which, to me, just emphasized how much he cares about animals.  For context, at the time he would have been researching, my dog had been stable for hours, and I would have assumed they would just monitor him and call me to come pick him up when he was ready. While I was there, I also observed a staff member sitting on the floor doing paperwork in a makeshift playpen with this sweet little Pitbull that was recovering from surgery because the Pitbull had anxiety.
Its clear everyone there cares about the animals that come through the door, and to me, that makes the biggest difference with the care you receive.  It makes you feel like they are truly invested in getting the best outcome.   Again, I cannot recommend the LP VEG enough.

When my sweet boy passed, VEG was the closest animal hospital and I am so glad it was. They were kind, patient, and supportive. I was immediately taken back (it was also 5:30AM) and 2-3 vet techs assessed the situation. They asked what happened and when I finished, they gently let me know he passed. They took me back to a room where I could be with my boy for as long as I needed. They gave me a pager to let them know if I needed something. The paperwork was quick and I got an email less than an hour later to make arrangements.

Parking is easy, it’s behind the building which is very helpful. Very thankful for the team.

This is the second time we have had to use VEG for our cat. Cannot recommend them highly enough!! They are collaborative, they listen to you and to your pet’s body language, and they want you to be with your pet as much as you’re open to it. Plus, very trans and queer friendly.

The entire staff is amazing despite being so busy and probably overwhelmed the night we came.

I had back-to-back visits here to put one of my dogs down and have to say they made it frictionless every step of the way. (Which unfortunately failed but we had one more night together)

They never once nickel and dimed me and understood the financial limitations I had for treatment options. They went above and beyond to try to accommodate and even when it was time to finally make the call, made sure I was supported and gave him some awesome treats to go out on a high note. Overall the most affordable end of life facility within miles and open 24 hours.

Hopefully I'll never have to come back but if I need them I know they'll be there.
Dr Swire , Dr Schanks and the entire were amazing, kind, professional and wonderful at answering all my questions. Most importantly taking care of my pup!

This was our first time ever taking a pet to the emergency room, and VEG made the experience as smooth as possible. Our 10-month-old miniature schnauzer woke up in the middle of the night whimpering and slightly shaking. He wasn’t putting any weight on his front left leg, and we knew something was wrong.

We arrived at VEG around 1 AM, and within 45 seconds of checking in, we were guided to the triage. Two technicians immediately came over, asked about what happened, and took his vital signs. The doctor arrived within minutes, performed a full examination, and quickly provided a diagnosis. She explained that it was most likely a soft tissue injury but also mentioned the more extreme possibility of a pinched nerve in the spine, given that he had injured the opposite shoulder a month ago. She set clear expectations, explaining that if he did not show signs of improvement within two weeks, she recommended a spinal x-ray from a neurology specialist to rule out more serious issues. VEG also provided a list of specialists in the Chicagoland area for follow-up care if needed.

They gave him a pain relief shot on the spot, then sent us home with additional pain relief and anti-inflammatory medication, which allowed us to keep our puppy comfortable while he recovered. While this was a mild case, we were in and out in about an hour—in the early hours of Monday morning.

It was incredible to see how efficient and well-organized the setup was. This place is built for quick, effective, and careful treatment for any type of situation—mild or severe. The doctors and technicians are truly exceptional, and we couldn’t have felt safer or more supported in what was a very scary situation for us. We are so thankful for their care and expertise.

Great Staff! And I mean seriously everyone; from the front desk person to the doctors to the manager. They were awesome and on point. They really helped my dog, wife and I through a very scary time. It was very evident from my experience that everyone here really loves animals and takes their roles very seriously. From literally the moment I stepped through the door I was engaged by the staff. The care my dog, Coney, got was second to none. If you are in an emergency situation you are in very good hands here! I really really hope I never have to come back but I feel better knowing that VEG is there if needed!
Incredible staff and experience. Highly recommend for emergencies. Took great care of my dog Daisy!

I would recommend VEG if your pet is bleeding out or needs immediate surgery. In any other scenario, I would avoid it at all costs. Be aware that VEG offers its employees production-based bonuses AKA they’re incentivized to push expensive diagnostics and procedures.

My dog contracted lepto and was advised by my vet to be hospitalized immediately. His kidney and liver levels were off the charts and he needed to begin treatment ASAP for a better chance at survival. Since the place my vet recommended was at maximum capacity, we brought him to VEG where he stayed hospitalized for roughly 4 days.

I stayed with my dog for almost the entirety of his hospitalization. During that time, I saw how much they deprioritized his treatment. Since they were constantly dealing with new emergencies, he was often left waiting for his various treatments, medications, and fluids for hours. They also said he would be taken on walks every 6 hours but that was never the case.

By day 2, since he still had trouble eating, they suggested placing an NG tube in him. After agreeing to have it placed that afternoon, they finally got around to it near midnight. They also said they’d give him food through it in the morning. By the time we took him out of there, they never once fed him through it.

VEG has an open floor plan where all the cages are kept along the perimeter of the room. It’s hectic there with surgeries, dogs barking, and dozens of people coming in and out. My dog was clearly stressed and agitated which led to him being constantly injected with expensive sedatives or painkillers despite his liver already struggling.

After witnessing his treatment, we made the difficult decision to discharge him. As soon as we mentioned “discharge”, the doctors that were always too busy to speak with us suddenly found time to push several tests and an ultrasound on us. After the ultrasound results came back with no clear signs of an emergency, we left.

Within 24 hours, we knew we made the right decision. His condition improved rapidly and continues to improve every day. With frequent visits to our wonderful vet, keeping track of his medications, and providing him with subcutaneous fluids, he's back to his old self.

All in all, we were extremely unhappy with how VEG treated our dog. The doctors were vague and unhelpful and only seemed to be on top of getting us to pay our invoice.

My cat and I waited for 8 (!!!) hours while my cat was suffering, having blood in her stool and vomiting, just for a basic X-ray and a subpar ultrasound. The vet, highlighting to me that "with his 20 years of experience", he was 100% certain that my cat had cancer. The radiologist also confidently diagnosed lymphoma, despite knowing that such a diagnosis requires a proper endoscopy and can rarely be diagnosed with certainty by radiology.

As a medically trained individual, I was highly skeptical of this cancer diagnosis. My cat has always has been on a holistic diet and supplements, and had perfect blood work and weight values just a month prior with her regular exams.

After two hours of waiting and dealing with chaos, I wanted to leave, but the doctor continued to pressure me into proceeding with the ultrasound and other unnecessary procedures despite knowing that for a proper lymphoma diagnosis an endoscopy is required.

In summary:
- 8 hours of distress for my cat and me.
- A $2.2K bill for an incorrect diagnosis and an additional $100 for Metronidazole.
- Misleading lab results and a wrong diagnosis.
- To make matters worse, the vet had the audacity to suggest euthanasia, claiming it was "okay" for my cat. I can’t help but wonder how many animals may have been misdiagnosed and unnecessarily euthanized at this facility due to poor equipment, overconfidence and general chaos.

After this experience, I took my cat to Medvet to see an internist. The endoscopy showed she had mild to moderate IBD (!), which is treatable with a diet change and supplements—nothing to do with cancer.

If you love your pet avoid this emergency clinic. Choose Medvet instead, where they have experienced specialists and advanced equipment, and they don’t rely on fear-mongering tactics to drive up costs.
